title: Attend your graduation project 2nd midterm presentation

The 2nd midterm presentation of the graduation project will be held on Thursday, October 8.

english: The 2nd-round interim presentation of the Graduation Project (졸업프로젝트) will take place on 8 Oct (Thu).
The announcement and your assigned module have been sent to the email address each student wrote on the submitted 면담확인서 (advisor meeting confirmation form). Please check your email.
Students who have not received the email must contact the staff member in charge, 김수진 (Kim Su-jin), at ksj2602@snu.ac.kr.

Emails are sent to the address written on the 면담확인서 (advisor meeting confirmation form). If you wrote an address such as Naver Mail and want to change it to your SNU account, please let the staff member know by email.
Attendance will be checked exactly on the hour. Please take care not to be late or absent without permission.
(If you cannot attend for a reason such as 예비군 (reserve forces training) or an academic conference, please inform the staff member in charge.)

In addition, the date of the 4th-round Final Poster Presentation of the Graduation Project has changed from 19 Nov (Thu) to 20 Nov (Fri). Please check the related schedule as well. (Check your email.)
<Teaching Assistants in Charge and Classrooms by Module>
*Inquiries: Department Office, Building 301 Room 308 / 김수진 (Kim Su-jin) (ksj2602@snu.ac.kr)
